metrics.label: Days Tmax > 25°C
metrics.definition: Expected annual number of days with HadUK-Grid daily maximum temperature strictly above 25°C. Calculated as the sum of calendar-month means across all available years, so published 2026 months are included without treating unpublished 2026 months as zero.

coverage.method: Calendar-month means are summed so incomplete 2026 coverage does not count unpublished months as zero.

metrics.label: Days Tmax > 28°C
metrics.definition: Expected annual number of days with HadUK-Grid daily maximum temperature strictly above 28°C. Calculated as the sum of calendar-month means across all available years, so published 2026 months are included without treating unpublished 2026 months as zero.

coverage.method: Calendar-month means are summed so incomplete 2026 coverage does not count unpublished months as zero.

metrics.label: Days Tmax > 30°C
metrics.definition: Expected annual number of days with HadUK-Grid daily maximum temperature strictly above 30°C. Calculated as the sum of calendar-month means across all available years, so published 2026 months are included without treating unpublished 2026 months as zero.

coverage.method: Calendar-month means are summed so incomplete 2026 coverage does not count unpublished months as zero.

metrics.label: Summer Tmax 95th percentile
metrics.definition: 95th percentile of all available June–August HadUK-Grid daily maximum temperatures in the selected 2016–2026 observation period.

metrics.label: Summer Tmax 99th percentile
metrics.definition: 99th percentile of all available June–August HadUK-Grid daily maximum temperatures in the selected 2016–2026 observation period.

metrics.label: Longest run Tmax > 25°C
metrics.definition: Longest observed consecutive run of days with HadUK-Grid daily maximum temperature strictly above 25°C. Runs reset at calendar-year boundaries and at any gap in the available monthly source record; 2026 is included through the latest published month.

coverage.method: Calendar-month means are summed so incomplete 2026 coverage does not count unpublished months as zero.

metrics.label: Tropical nights: Tmin > 20°C
metrics.definition: Expected annual number of days whose HadUK-Grid daily minimum temperature is strictly above 20°C, calculated from calendar-month means across all available years. HadUK-Grid daily Tmin follows the Met Office observation-day convention rather than a literal sunset-to-sunrise minimum.

coverage.method: Calendar-month means are summed so incomplete 2026 coverage does not count unpublished months as zero.

metrics.label: Air-frost days
metrics.definition: Expected annual number of days with HadUK-Grid daily minimum air temperature strictly below 0°C. An air frost is defined from Tmin; a day whose maximum temperature remains below freezing is instead an ice day. Calculated as the sum of calendar-month means across all available years, so published 2026 months are included without treating unpublished months as zero.

coverage.method: Calendar-month means are summed so incomplete 2026 coverage does not count unpublished months as zero.

metrics.label: Winter Tmin 5th percentile
metrics.definition: 5th percentile of HadUK-Grid daily minimum temperature across complete December–February winters. Only complete DJF winters are used, so the statistic is not biased by partial seasonal coverage.

coverage.method: Only complete December–February (DJF) winters are included; partial winters at either end of the source period are excluded.

metrics.label: PM2.5 annual mean
metrics.definition: 3-year arithmetic mean of Defra Pollution Climate Mapping (PCM) modelled background annual mean PM2.5 concentration for 2022–2024.

coverage.method: Arithmetic mean across annual PCM grids; a cell is included only when all selected years have a value.

metrics.label: NO₂ annual mean
metrics.definition: 3-year arithmetic mean of Defra Pollution Climate Mapping (PCM) modelled background annual mean nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) concentration for 2022–2024.

coverage.method: Arithmetic mean across annual PCM grids; a cell is included only when all selected years have a value.

metrics.label: PM10 annual mean
metrics.definition: 3-year arithmetic mean of Defra Pollution Climate Mapping (PCM) modelled background annual mean PM10 concentration for 2022–2024.

coverage.method: Arithmetic mean across annual PCM grids; a cell is included only when all selected years have a value.

metrics.label: Ozone exceedance days
metrics.definition: 3-year arithmetic mean of the annual number of days where Defra PCM's daily maximum running 8-hour mean ozone concentration exceeds 120 µg/m³, using 2022–2024 grids.

coverage.method: Arithmetic mean across annual PCM grids; a cell is included only when all selected years have a value.

hadukgrid.citation: Met Office; Hollis, D.; Carlisle, E.; Kendon, M.; Packman, S.; Doherty, A. (2026): HadUK-Grid Gridded Climate Observations on a 1km grid over the UK, v1.3.2.ceda (1836-2025). NERC EDS Centre for Environmental Data Analysis, 23 June 2026.
hadukgrid.method_citation: Hollis, D.; McCarthy, M. P.; Kendon, M.; Legg, T.; Simpson, I. (2019): HadUK-Grid - A new UK dataset of gridded climate observations. Geoscience Data Journal, 6, 151-159.
hadukgrid.derived_product_notice: Goldilocks Map climate metrics are derived from HadUK-Grid and are not an official Met Office product.
hadukgrid.note: HadUK-Grid is a gridded/interpolated climate-observation dataset; a grid cell is not a physical thermometer measurement at that exact point.

defra-pcm.provider: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra)
defra-pcm.dataset: UK-AIR Pollution Climate Mapping (PCM) background pollution data
defra-pcm.attribution: Source: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) via uk-air.defra.gov.uk, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
defra-pcm.derived_product_notice: Goldilocks Map Pollution metrics are 2022–2024 arithmetic means derived from annual Defra PCM grids; they are not official Defra products.
defra-pcm.note: PCM values are modelled background concentrations/metrics rather than measurements at each grid-cell centre. Defra updates PCM modelling methods over time, so annual grids should not be treated as a perfectly homogeneous observational time series.

data_pruning.action: Exclude these eight 1 km cells from all HadUK-Grid-derived metrics before LOD construction.
data_pruning.reason: A full 2016-01 to 2026-08 audit comparing each daily Tmin with the Tmax covering the same 24-hour observation period found severe interpolation inconsistencies at every St Kilda cell. All UK cells with ordering errors greater than 10°C were these eight cells, and all tropical-night candidate events with ordering errors greater than 5°C occurred in them.
